nodes.label: Olmo 3 (7B & 32B) Model Family
nodes.rationale: Olmo 3 is a family of 7B and 32B models (Base, Instruct, Think variants, plus DPO and RLVR final models) trained on the Dolma 3 dataset. 7B: 32 layers, hidden 4096, 32 Q/KV heads, 65,536 context, 5.93T tokens. 32B: 64 layers, hidden 5120, 40 Q heads, 8 KV heads, 5.50T tokens.

nodes.label: Olmo 3 Three-Stage Training
nodes.rationale: Three-stage procedure: stage 1 pretraining on dolma3 (mostly web data), stage 2 midtraining on dolma3-dolmino high-quality targeted data, stage 3 long-context on dolma3-longmino (a portion of longer documents). The 32B mixes are slightly more refined and recommended. For 32B, model merging (souping by parameter averaging) is used at multiple points: souping two separate midtraining runs and souping the final three long-context checkpoints.
